overview_description.description: Sadeem is the world’s first multi-patented flood and traffic information system with active networks to save lives and money in realtime. They offer a novel early detection and monitoring flood system for urban areas and drainage systems. Their holistic solution consists in a combination of sensors network, mobile applications and visualization tools to face floods in a better way and mitigate its effects.
